name: dest-tint
description: test.md 'Destructable tint at editor 7000+': dest-tint.w3x (make-dest-tint.mjs: one destructable of each of the game's 344 types, LTlt with variations 1-6, flags 0, 1, 4 and lives 0-99; a text trigger names them all) opened and saved by the editor (build 24371, editor 7003); the SetDestructableVertexColor lines of its script against Studio's (w3.script.generate), as a set. The editor puts every game type at 255, 255, 255; tints come from the map's object data only (war3map.w3b and war3mapSkin.w3b): an original's change, a custom type's own fields (LTe3 with bvcg 40 gives 255, 40, 255; B002 on LTe3 with bvcb 7 gives 255, 255, 7, not 255, 40, 7). Placement lines (position, angle, scale) are left out: the editor snaps them on opening.
